newsitem.title: USA: Sudbury rejects Park-Ohio bid as inadequate.
newsitem.headline: Sudbury rejects Park-Ohio bid as inadequate.

text.p: Sudbury Inc. said Monday that it rejected an unsolicited offer from Park-Ohio Industries Inc. to buy the company for $170 million, or $11 a share, citing the bid as inadequate.

The industrial supply company said it would continue to explore ways to maximize shareholder value, but that no decision has been made that a transaction with any company is necessarily in the best interests of Sudbury stockholders.
Last week, Sudbury said Wall Street firm Alex. Brown & Sons Inc. had contacted a number of companies in July and August to examine their interest in acquiring the company.
Sudbury stock fell 12.5 cents to $12.625 in late afternoon trade Monday. Park-Ohio shares were up 37.5 cents at $15.
